We think that the problem with running the tests has to do with the node version (https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v22.18.0), so we updated the README to clarify the dependency node >= 22.22.1. Also we thought about deprecating the aiken tests but didn't remove the template, that's why it was failing, but now we updated it to support the new circuit, so you should be able to run aiken check .

Regarding the datum in the utxo, we're aware that Plutus V3 allows scripts to spend utxos without any datum, but mesh's transaction builder isn't updated yet and enforces the datum regardless of the script version, so any attempt to avoid it results in error.
